init_mlx_vlm_model: initialize HuggingFaceMlxModel with enabled flag, artifacts path, accelerator options, and VLM options
call_mlx_model_process_pages: call HuggingFaceMlxModel to process a batch of document pages and generate VLM predictions
stream_generate_vlm_output: stream generate document tags from an MLX vision-language model given an image and prompt
apply_chat_template_vlm: apply a chat template to an MLX VLM processor and config with a prompt and number of images
download_mlx_model_artifacts: download MLX VLM model artifacts from a HuggingFace repo ID to a local cache path
